How to set up the \"DSH Handoff\" bookmark

1. Tap "Copy bookmarklet code" above.
2. Open Chrome and go to chat.deepseek.com.
3. Tap the ⋮ menu, then tap ☆ to bookmark the page.
4. Tap Edit (on the "Bookmarked" message, or long-press the bookmark under Bookmarks), rename it to "DSH Handoff", replace the URL with the copied code, and tap Save.

To run it: be signed in on chat.deepseek.com, tap the address bar, type "DSH Handoff" and tap the suggestion with the STAR icon (not a search suggestion). A panel appears at the bottom of the page with "Open in DSH" and "Copy session instead".

Note: Chrome removes "javascript:" if you paste the code into the address bar, so it only works as a bookmark.

1. Get the bookmarklet code onto your computer (for example, send the copied code to yourself).
2. Right-click the bookmarks bar and choose Add page or Add bookmark.
3. Name it "DSH Handoff", paste the code as the URL, and save.
4. Open chat.deepseek.com signed in and click the bookmark. On a computer, tap "Copy session instead", then paste the session into this app's "Paste session" field.

• \"Open in DSH\" opens this app on the phone and passes the session directly. If you did not start from the app first, DSH shows the account and asks before using it.\n• \"Copy session instead\" copies the session so you can paste it into the \"Paste session\" field above. Use it if the link does not open the app.
The session is a live sign-in credential for your DeepSeek account. Use it only on your own device and never share it with anyone.
